name: io.github.jadenpxrk/piazza-mcp
description: Read-only Piazza access: activity, search, unread posts, full threads, and course info

environmentVariables.name: PIAZZA_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Piazza account email. Not needed after 'mcp-piazza login'.

environmentVariables.name: PIAZZA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Piazza account password. Not needed after 'mcp-piazza login'.

environmentVariables.name: PIAZZA_COOKIE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the saved session file.

environmentVariables.name: PIAZZA_FENCE_CONTENT
environmentVariables.description: Mark post text as untrusted data.

environmentVariables.name: PIAZZA_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to keep feeds and posts in memory.
